situations.title: 발열 시작·양상 문진
situations.tagline: I've had a fever off and on for three days now.
situations.brief: 발열의 경과와 동반 증상을 체계적으로 문진하세요.
keyPhrases: When did the fever start, and how high has it gotten?
Do you have a cough, sore throat, burning urine, or any pain?
Has anything made it better or worse?

situations.title: 활력·감염원 초기 사정
situations.tagline: I just feel hot and worn out — I don't know what's causing it.
situations.brief: 활력징후를 확인하고 감염원을 초기 스크리닝하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me check your temperature, pulse, and breathing first.
I'll ask about a few common sources of infection.
Any pain when you pee, cough, or a wound anywhere?

situations.title: 격리 필요성 판단
situations.tagline: I've been coughing a lot and I have a fever — do I need a mask?
situations.brief: 호흡기 증상을 선별하고 격리·마스크 필요성을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Because of the cough and fever, I'll have you wear a mask.
We may place you in a separate room to protect others.
Have you been around anyone sick or traveled recently?

situations.title: 해열제 투여 설명
situations.tagline: Can I get something to bring this fever down? I'm miserable.
situations.brief: 해열제의 용량과 재측정 계획을 알기 쉽게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: This will help lower your fever and make you more comfortable.
We'll recheck your temperature in about an hour.
Keep drinking fluids — that helps too.

situations.title: 여행력·접촉력 문진
situations.tagline: I just got back from a trip abroad and now I've got this fever.
situations.brief: 여행지·접촉력을 문진해 유입감염을 스크리닝하세요.
keyPhrases: Where did you travel, and when did you get back?
Did you get any bug bites or eat anything unusual?
Was anyone you traveled with also sick?

situations.title: 폐렴 의심 발열
situations.tagline: I've had a fever and this deep cough, and I'm getting short of breath.
situations.brief: 기침·SpO2를 사정하고 영상·항생제 계획을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Your cough and shortness of breath make us think of pneumonia.
We'll get a chest X-ray and check your oxygen level.
If it's pneumonia, we'll start antibiotics promptly.

situations.title: 요로감염 발열 노인
situations.tagline: Mom's been confused and feverish, but no cough or anything obvious.
situations.brief: 비전형 발현과 섬망을 감별하며 요로감염 가능성을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: In older adults, a urine infection can show up as confusion.
We'll check her urine and blood to look for infection.
Has she had any change in urination or new incontinence?

situations.title: 봉와직염 발열
situations.tagline: My leg's gotten red, hot, and swollen, and now I've got a fever.
situations.brief: 홍반 경계를 표시하고 진행을 관찰하며 항생제를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm marking the edge of the redness to see if it spreads.
The fever means the infection may be spreading, so we'll treat it.
Tell me if the pain suddenly gets much worse than it looks.

situations.title: 인플루엔자 시즌 선별
situations.tagline: Everyone at work has the flu and now I've got body aches and fever too.
situations.brief: 검사와 항바이러스제 적응을 선별하고 격리를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll swab you to check for the flu.
If it's positive and it's early, an antiviral may help.
Please keep the mask on to protect others while you're here.

situations.title: 면역저하 발열
situations.tagline: I'm on chemo and I just spiked a fever — my nurse said to come in right away.
situations.brief: 호중구감소성 발열 가능성을 인지하고 신속한 대응을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: With chemo, a fever is an emergency, so we act fast.
We're drawing cultures and starting antibiotics quickly.
We'll keep you protected from other infections while you're here.

situations.title: 소아 고열 보호자
situations.tagline: His fever hit 104 and I'm terrified he'll have a seizure.
situations.brief: 열성경련 우려를 다루고 해열·수분 관리를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll bring the fever down and keep him comfortable.
Most fever seizures are brief and don't cause lasting harm.
Keep offering fluids, and let me know if he becomes hard to wake.

situations.title: 발열+발진 감별
situations.tagline: I've got a fever and this rash popped up — I started a new medication last week.
situations.brief: 감염성·약물성 발진을 감별하기 위해 병력을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: The new medication makes me wonder if the rash is a drug reaction.
We'll look at how it's spreading and whether it blisters.
Do you have any mouth sores or eye irritation?

situations.title: 수막염 의심 두통·발열
situations.tagline: I've got a splitting headache, fever, and my neck is so stiff I can't look down.
situations.brief: 경부강직을 사정하고 요추천자 등 검사 필요성을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The stiff neck with fever and headache concerns me about meningitis.
We'll need a spinal tap to check the fluid around your brain.
Does bright light bother your eyes right now?

situations.title: 결핵 의심 만성기침
situations.tagline: I've had this cough for weeks, night sweats, and I've lost weight.
situations.brief: 음압격리 필요성을 판단하고 결핵 검사를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: A long cough with night sweats and weight loss can suggest TB.
We'll place you in a special isolation room right away.
We'll test your sputum to check for tuberculosis.

situations.title: 여행 후 열대열 의심
situations.tagline: I got back from a malaria region two weeks ago and now I have chills and fever.
situations.brief: 말라리아 노출을 확인하고 신속 검사·격리 판단을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Fever after travel to a malaria area needs urgent testing.
Did you take any malaria prevention pills, and finish them?
We'll run a rapid blood test to check for it now.

situations.title: 호중구감소성 발열 패혈증
situations.tagline: I feel like I'm crashing…
situations.brief: 즉시 광범위 항생제 투여를 시행하고 팀에 SBAR로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Neutropenic and now hypotensive — this is septic until proven otherwise.
Cultures are drawn; give broad-spectrum antibiotics within the hour.
Febrile neutropenia with sepsis — I need fluids running and a physician now.

situations.title: 수막구균혈증 진행
situations.tagline: These purple spots just appeared and he's getting so cold and drowsy.
situations.brief: 자반·쇼크를 인지하고 즉시 항생제와 격리를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Those purple spots with drowsiness are a dangerous sign — we're acting now.
We're giving antibiotics immediately and starting fluids.
We're isolating him and will need to protect close contacts too.

situations.title: 괴사성 근막염
situations.tagline: The pain in my leg is way worse than it looks — it's unbearable.
situations.brief: 소견 대비 심한 통증을 인지하고 외과 협진을 긴급 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Pain this severe with a fever worries me about a deep infection.
We're calling surgery urgently to evaluate you.
We're starting strong antibiotics and fluids right now.
goals: 소견 대비 심한 통증을 위험 신호로 인지한다

situations.title: 독성쇼크증후군
situations.tagline: I feel awful — high fever, this red rash all over, and now I'm so dizzy.
situations.brief: 발진·저혈압·다장기 침범을 인지하고 신속 소생을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: The rash, fever, and low pressure point to toxic shock.
We're pouring in fluids and starting antibiotics now.
Have you had any recent wound, surgery, or been using tampons?

situations.title: 발열 급속악화 쇼크 이행
situations.tagline: I was okay an hour ago but now I can barely stay awake…
situations.brief: 패혈증 번들을 가동하고 쇼크 이행을 팀에 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Your pressure is dropping fast, so we're moving quickly now.
We're giving fluids wide open and antibiotics right away.
Stay with me — I'm getting the team in here.

situations.title: 고위험 감염 이송 인계
situations.tagline: Transferring a suspected high-consequence infection — need a clean handoff.
situations.brief: 격리·배양·항생제 정보를 포함해 받는 팀에 명확히 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Suspected meningococcemia — he's on airborne and contact precautions.
Cultures were drawn and first antibiotic dose given at nineteen-hundred.
Last pressure eighty-five systolic on fluids — please continue isolation.
